_comment: Shared magazine routing rules. Read by the engine (engine/src/engine/agents/routing.py, mounted read-only at /app/routing-rules.json) and by the frontend (src/lib/routingRules.ts). Patterns must work in BOTH Python re and JavaScript RegExp: no lookbehind, no inline flags, no named groups. Order of evaluation: nasa, then ai, then ai_security.

prompt_guidance: Routing rules (these override your own judgement):

- Any article from, or about, a publisher of an AI model, an AI agent harness, or a known AI extension/plugin (for example OpenAI/ChatGPT, Anthropic/Claude, Google DeepMind/Gemini, Meta AI/Llama, Mistral, xAI/Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, Hugging Face, Cursor, LangChain, Nous Research/Hermes Agent, Perplexity, Microsoft/GitHub Copilot) belongs in AI Frontier (neural-hardware).

- Any NASA story (nasa.gov or about NASA) belongs in Science Frontiers (weird-and-wild), EXCEPT: NASA money, budgets, contracts or building/construction goes in Just the News (just-the-news-thats-fit-to-print), and purely theoretical or speculative NASA concepts (warp drives, far-future propulsion ideas, sci-fi style concepts) go in Dark Matter (dark-matter).
- General cybersecurity news with no AI angle belongs in Tech Pulse (tech-pulse); security stories about AI belong in AI Frontier.
